title: `default`
description: Documents the value a server or client should assume when an optional parameter is omitted.
question: Is the declared default value preserved at each capture boundary?
notes: Every adapter now hands the agent the source default of 20. CrewAI rewrote it as recently as crewai-tools 1.14.7; the generated args_schema preserves it at 1.15.1.

verdict.headline: Preserved at all five boundaries.
verdict.detail: The default survives every adaptation measured here. This row changed when CrewAI moved from 1.14.7 to 1.15.1, which is the kind of silent repair that only shows up if you keep re-measuring.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP tool schemas declaring default values.
known_issues: A changed default can cause a caller and server to assume different behavior for the same omitted argument.
why: Defaults communicate omission behavior. Losing or changing one can alter calls without changing the visible parameter type.
reproduce: uv run mcp-mirror scan "uv run python fixtures/tricky_server.py" --runner managed --frameworks crewai,langchain,openai_agents,pydantic_ai --spec-version 2025-11-25 --job J2
